_schema.description: Single source of truth for every physical constant in the hexapod model. Nothing in core/, bindings/, sim/ or tests/ may hard-code a value that appears here.

status_meanings.decided: Fixed by a numbered decision or a vendor specification. Changes only by a new decision.
status_meanings.measured: Produced by a hardware-workstream measurement campaign. Carries an uncertainty.
status_meanings.provisional: A working number standing in for a measurement that has not happened. Will change.
status_meanings.unspecified: No authoritative value exists yet. Reading this raises ConstantError by design.

_schema.precision_convention: D147 - double precision throughout, no intermediate rounding. Angles 4 dp in degrees, lengths 4 dp in millimetres.

controlled_dof_per_leg.note: Coxa yaw + femur pitch. The tibia servo exists on this platform but is held at a constant commanded angle theta_3_deg (D199).

servo_count_installed.note: Supersedes the 12x DS3225MG of D48. Platform ships 18x ZX20D serial bus servos, 3 per leg.

coxa_length_mm.note: Named L1 in PROJECT_01 §5.1. Renamed here to avoid collision with leg identifier 'L1'. Derived for the pre-PROJECT_04 frame; awaiting measurement of the Yeahbot frame.

femur_length_mm.note: Named L2 in PROJECT_01 §5.1. Ceiling 97.6 mm. Derived for the pre-PROJECT_04 frame; awaiting measurement.

tibia_length_mm.source: PROJECT_04 §3 refers to L3; the defining document is PROJECT_02, which MP-WS has not received.
tibia_length_mm.note: BLOCKER. PROJECT_01 §5.1 modelled a rigid tibia with no L3. PROJECT_02 introduced one. No value may be invented here.

theta_3_deg.source: D199, via PROJECT_04 §3; default value defined in PROJECT_02, not received.
theta_3_deg.note: BLOCKER. Configuration parameter with a fixed default. v1 -> v2 is a config change, no rewiring.

theta_2_neutral_deg.note: Femur pitch at mid-stance. A solve variable with a floor, not a free choice.

coxa_positions_mm.note: SUPERSEDED IN PRINCIPLE. PROJECT_04 §2 states this table was derived for a body plate that no longer exists. Awaiting measurement of the Yeahbot frame. Two open questions raised with coordination: (a) 56.57 is given to 2 dp but D147 requires 4 dp; if the intent is 80/sqrt(2) the value is 56.5685. (b) whether the Yeahbot frame is even hexagonal in this arrangement.

leg_neutral_direction_deg.note: Lateral neutral. beta_mount and beta_neutral stay separate (D23) - this table is beta_neutral only.

body_bob_budget_mm.note: Peak-to-peak. This, not servo torque, is what limits stride.

swing_velocity_profile.note: The peak/mean ratio of pi/2 is DELIBERATELY NOT STORED HERE. It is a consequence of the profile and must be computed. Storing it would be the exact failure the hard-coded-constant guard exists to catch.

command_step_deg.note: Per bus command. Supersedes 0.4392 deg per PCA9685 count. Third member of the hard-coded-constant guard (PROJECT_04 §4).

servo_speed_no_load_deg_s.note: Vendor no-load figure. Supersedes the provisional 200 deg/s.

servo_speed_loaded_deg_s.source: PROJECT_04 §2 - to be measured by the hardware workstream.
servo_speed_loaded_deg_s.note: MP2 deliverable. Any timing claim that needs a loaded speed must fail loudly until this exists.

a_eff_max_mm.note: Effective moment arm ceiling at 2.15 kg, derived from the 20 kg*cm stall torque.

payload_mass_kg.note: The mass the a_eff_max_mm figure was taken at. Unweighed.
